semiconductor_relevance: High — Nippon Pulse Motor specializes in various equipment essential for semiconductor assembly and packaging processes.
summary: Nippon Pulse Motor provides a range of equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, including Tape Automated Bonding (TAB) and Bumped Tape Automated Bonding (BTAB) systems. Their offerings also encompass lithography systems for wafer-level packaging, cleaning and washing equipment, and dicing and sawing tools, making them a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector.
